retrieved.educational: Master deploying efficient models and evaluating LLM tasks at a granular level.• The Vision Transformer Architecture: The Vision Transformer uses a transformer architecture, similar to BERT, but adapted for images. Instead of pro cessing text tokens, it processes image patches. Images are divided into 16x16 pixel patches. These patches are treated like tokens in text processing, allowin g the transformer to handle image data effectively. Each image patch is embedded into a vector, and positional embeddings are added to retain the spatial information of the patches. The Vision Transformer is pre -trained on the ImageNet dataset, which contains 14 million images and over 21,000 classes. ○ This pre -training helps the model learn basic image recognition tasks, similar to how BERT is pre -trained on text data. The Vision Transformer can be used for various image -related tasks, such as object recognition, by leveraging its ability to process and understand image data. • Using Cross -Attention to mix data modalities Function: Cross -attention lets the decoder access information from the encoder. It's crucial when input and output data types differ, like images to text.• Mechanism: The decoder generates queries, and the encoder provides keys and values.• Process: The decoder uses these keys and values to create the output.• Example: In models like T5, cross -attention helps the decoder understand encoded information from the encoder. • Code For Visual QA -our visual question answering machine and data A Visual Question Answering (VQA) system It is an AI model designed to answer questions about images. ○ It processes both an image and a text question about that image. ○ The system combines the information from the image and the text using cross -attention and then uses a decoder, like GPT -2, to generate an answer. ○• New Section 1 Page 33 New Section 1 Page 34 New Section 1 Page 35 USING OUR VQA SYSTEM New Section 1 Page 36 New Section 1 Page 37 Introduction to reinforcement learning from feedback Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) : This method fine -tunes large language models (LLMs) using feedback from human evaluators to align the model's output with human preferences. • Three -Step Process: Train the model on a large corpus to learn grammar and specific tasks.○ Define and Train a Reward System: Use feedback (from humans or AI) to create a reward system that scores the model's output.○ Update the LLM: Use reinforcement learning to adjust the model's parameters based on the reward system's scores.○ RL FROM F -DETAILED FLAN -T5 It is an open -source language model from Google that has been instruction fine -tuned, meaning it has been trained to follow instructions and generate responses accordingly.
